info.title: Bharat Sourcer API
info.description: Demo or live YouTube and project-page extraction with optional Firestore job persistence.

delete.description:
Permanently delete an owned project: its parts list, offers, conversation and
share link. Work still running for it stops at its next save.

post.description: Copy a shared project into the caller's own projects (account or guest).

ActionRecord.title: ActionRecord
ActionRecord.description: One append-only history entry for a decided or finished chat action.

BuyableSpec.title: BuyableSpec
BuyableSpec.description:
What to buy for a BOM line, stated the way Indian sellers list parts.

`ai_inferred` specs come from the extraction call (one call per job, not per line);
`seed` specs are the deterministic fallback built from the part name only. Every
inferred value carries a reason and the whole spec is editable (`origin: user`).

BuyerDecision.title: BuyerDecision
BuyerDecision.description:
What the AI buyer decided for a hard line, in plain words (docs/contracts/ai-buyer.md).

value: a part value the source did not state, worked out from the circuit (the spec's
param carries the same reason). fit/offer_url: the listing it chose when nothing was
accepted (substitute offers are grade B with the changes listed). searched: extra store
searches it asked for. Decisions are suggestions for review, never verified facts.

CartPlans.title: CartPlans
CartPlans.description: Suggestions only: plans never change the user's selection.

CatalogMatch.title: CatalogMatch
CatalogMatch.description: Deterministic catalogue lookup of a part name; reference facts, not seller facts.

CodePatch.title: CodePatch
CodePatch.description:
Code changes for a substituted part; never tested on hardware.

origin: curated (a maintained recipe) or ai_draft (model-written, validated, must be
accepted by the owner). check: not_checked until a compile check finishes (`compile`),
then compiles or compile_failed. status unavailable always carries a reason; notes
always list the non-code changes.

CompatFinding.title: CompatFinding
CompatFinding.description: One deterministic rule result; `grade` is the floor this finding imposes.

CompileCheck.title: CompileCheck
CompileCheck.description:
One compile-only check of a code patch in the isolated runner (code-adapt tier 3).

queued until the runner reports. compiles / compile_failed come from arduino-cli for
`fqbn` with the pinned `core`; a compile never uploads, runs or tests on hardware.
unavailable always carries a reason. A queued check past `expires_at` has timed out and
can be requested again. AI drafts that fail get at most two repair rounds (`repairs`);
each round replaces the patch's diffs and resets `accepted`.

CopiedFrom.title: CopiedFrom
CopiedFrom.description:
Provenance of a copy. The source project is not identified: its owner shared a
link, not their project id.

CostAmount.title: CostAmount
CostAmount.description: An auditable amount; `unknown` has no amount, only the parts that could be estimated.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Estimate from seller-published prices and dated policy and tax assumptions; not a final payable total. Check the seller's checkout.

CostBreakdown.title: CostBreakdown
CostBreakdown.description: Estimated cost of chosen offers; never a final payable or checkout total.

CostEstimate.title: CostEstimate
CostEstimate.description:
Estimated Gemini spend for this job from logged token counts and a dated price table.

An estimate for budgeting, not a bill: grounding queries are priced as if the monthly
free tier were used up. `run_usd` is the current sourcing run, which the budget limits.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description:
Model-reported provenance for an extracted BOM line.

`source` defaults to `video` so snapshots saved before project-page support still
validate. Video evidence carries a timestamp. Project-page evidence carries the fetched
document `url` and a `quote` the server found verbatim (whitespace-normalised) in it.
Code evidence is deterministic: the repository `file` and 1-based `line`, the line's
text as `quote`, and a `url` to that line. YouTube description evidence carries a
`quote` (at most 300 characters) the server found verbatim in the video's description
and the canonical video `url`; it is dropped from responses 30 days after
`Job.video_meta.fetched_at` (YouTube API Services retention policy).

ImportReference.title: ImportReference
ImportReference.description: Unit price from a US/global distributor, used only for the import comparison.

ItemConflict.title: ItemConflict
ItemConflict.description: Sources disagree about this line; nothing is picked silently (see multi-source-intake).

refresh_limit.title: Refresh Limit
refresh_limit.description: Seller refresh batch limit; null for exempt testing accounts.

JobVideoMeta.title: JobVideoMeta
JobVideoMeta.description:
YouTube Data API snippet facts kept on a job; never the full description.

API data must be refreshed or deleted after 30 days: once `fetched_at` is older,
responses clear `title`, `channel`, `published_at` and `links`, drop description
quotes from evidence and set `expired`.

LineImage.title: LineImage
LineImage.description: The one image to show for a line, resolved in a fixed order (recommendations.md).

LineRecommendation.title: LineRecommendation
LineRecommendation.description: Deterministic recommendation for one line; reasons explain every scoring factor.

Lookalike.title: Lookalike
Lookalike.description: A part easily confused with this line; a warning, never a suggested substitute.

rules.title: Rules
rules.default: Show these Google Maps sources immediately after the summary, viewable within one interaction; link each title to its URI and do not modify the text "Google Maps".

summary_label.title: Summary Label
summary_label.default: Shops likely to carry these parts — call first; stock is not confirmed

OfferMatch.title: OfferMatch

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Recommendations are automatic and deterministic; check each seller page and checkout before ordering. Totals are estimates, not a payable amount.

OrderPlan.title: OrderPlan
OrderPlan.description: Seller-grouped order built from selections, else recommendations; an estimate only.

PartChip.title: PartChip
PartChip.description: The main chip or module can, as fractions of the body.

Pin.title: Pin
Pin.description: One header pin; `name` is the silkscreen label wires refer to.

ProjectContext.title: ProjectContext
ProjectContext.description:
The model's reading of what the project is; AI-inferred, never verified.

`title` and `description` are written by the model and editable by the owner
(`*_source` records who wrote the current value). `summary` stays the model's own
understanding after analysing the source and is not editable.

ProjectOverview.title: ProjectOverview
ProjectOverview.description: AI-inferred drawing of the project; never verified against the physical board.

ReconciledLine.title: ReconciledLine
ReconciledLine.description: A line the reconcile pass folded into another or left out (reconcile.py); AI-decided.

RefreshLineResult.title: RefreshLineResult
RefreshLineResult.description: Snapshot of one refreshed line when its batch ended; later refreshes do not edit it.

ResolvedSpec.title: ResolvedSpec
ResolvedSpec.description: An open spec question the drawing settled, so the maker is not asked it.

SafetyFlag.title: SafetyFlag
SafetyFlag.description: Hard-coded rule output (`safety.py`) with templated text; never written by a model.

SafetyTrigger.title: SafetyTrigger
SafetyTrigger.description: Which saved text made a deterministic safety rule fire.

SellerSearchSummary.title: SellerSearchSummary
SellerSearchSummary.description: Direct seller-catalogue search for one line. Candidate URLs are unverified leads.

SharedProject.title: SharedProject
SharedProject.description:
Read-only, redacted project view for share links and exports.

Excludes the job id, job token, owner identity, chat history, events, resistor
advice and grounded-search attribution; nothing here grants access to the job.

SourceReport.title: SourceReport
SourceReport.description: How one submitted source was read during extraction.

SpecConflict.title: SpecConflict
SpecConflict.description: Seller sources disagree; the field is left unknown rather than picked.

SpecParam.title: SpecParam
SpecParam.description: One buyable parameter. `si_value` is filled by the server's unit normaliser.

TrustSignals.title: TrustSignals
TrustSignals.description: Deterministic, free seller checks. Absent evidence is recorded, never assumed.

VideoLink.title: VideoLink
VideoLink.description: One link from a YouTube description; only project pages are followed as sources.
